sloka: द्रुम वर्षाणि मुंचन्तः शिला वर्षाणि राक्षसाः ।तद् बभूव अद्भुतम् युद्धम् तुमुलम् रोम हर्षणम् ॥३-२५-३४॥
transliteration: druma varṣāṇi muṁcantaḥ śilā varṣāṇi rākṣasāḥ ।tad babhūva adbhutam yuddham tumulam roma harṣaṇam ॥3-25-34॥

translations.english: As the infuriated demons again hurtled towards Rama, filling the quarters and the intermediate directions and raining missiles, Rama aimed at them dazzling gandharvastras, producing a frightening warcry.
